hits.title: Jorak: Reference-free detection of abliteration in open-source LLMs
hits.quantity_described: Weights-only SVD alignment scars: global alignment A (full ablation), band alignment B (localized/stealthy ablation), subspace alignment S (bottom-k shared subspace); plus activations axis-health (Cohen's d) and behavioral refusal rate; classified into 4 provenance buckets and plotted on a weight-severance x refusal 4-bucket plane; a `compare` CLI overlays several single-model scans on one plane

hits.quote: Principle. Abliteration orthogonalizes the refusal direction r̂ out of the weights that write into the residual stream (o_proj, down_proj): W' = (I - r̂r̂^T)W, so r̂^T W' = 0. ... Weights — spectral signature (SVD) (the smoking-gun, CPU, no inference). Three signals: global alignment A (full ablation), band alignment B (localized/stealthy ablation, Heretic-style), and subspace alignment S (bottom-k shared subspace -- catches multi-direction ablation, e.g. OBLITERATUS n_directions > 1, which a single u_min dilutes).

hits.title: CrossLayerAlignmentAnalyzer (module of OBLITERATUS)
hits.quantity_described: Pairwise cosine-similarity matrix between per-layer refusal directions of a single model; direction_persistence_score (0=independent per layer, 1=single persistent direction); cluster_count; angular_drift / total_geodesic_distance of the direction across layers; mean_adjacent_cosine

hits.quote: A key open question in abliteration research is whether refusal is mediated by the *same* direction propagated through the residual stream, or by *different* directions at each layer. This module answers that question quantitatively by computing pairwise cosine similarities between refusal directions across all layers. ... direction_persistence_score: float # 0=independent per layer, 1=single direction ... Contribution: We also compute the "refusal direction flow" -- the cumulative angular drift of the refusal direction through the network, measured as the total geodesic distance on the unit hypersphere.
